englishOverrides.Enterprise.employee.confirmBulkDesc: This lists all active employees who do not yet have an account and provisions them in batches, not limited by the current page size. Progress is shown here. About {count} active employees currently have no account; those who already have one are skipped automatically.

Local execution protection could not be established because recovery storage is unavailable or invalid, its safety limit was reached, or another RunId is already present. No execution or reconciliation was started. Keep this page open and contact an administrator.
